name: Code 128
description: A versatile choice for internal product codes, stock labels and shipping workflows. Supports letters, numbers and common symbols.
hint: Letters, numbers and symbols. Great for SKUs and internal inventory.

name: EAN-13
description: A 13-digit retail barcode used for products sold internationally. Use an existing assigned product number; generating an image does not register a product number.
hint: Enter 12 digits to calculate the check digit, or all 13 to validate it.

name: UPC-A
description: A 12-digit retail barcode commonly used in the US and Canada. Use the product number assigned to your item.
hint: Enter 11 digits to calculate the check digit, or all 12 to validate it.

name: Code 39
description: A simple format for internal asset tags and equipment identification, using uppercase letters, numbers and a small set of symbols.
hint: Use A–Z, 0–9, spaces, or these symbols: - . $ / + %.

name: EAN-8
description: An 8-digit retail format for small products with limited packaging space. It requires an appropriate assigned EAN-8 number; it is not a shortened EAN-13.
hint: Enter 7 digits to calculate the check digit, or all 8 to validate it.

name: QR Code
description: Share a website link or a short message with a phone camera. These are static QR codes: the content is embedded in the image, without a redirect service.
hint: Enter a complete URL, including https://, or any short text.

name: Data Matrix
description: A compact two-dimensional format for tracking small items and components. This tool produces ordinary Data Matrix codes, not GS1 DataMatrix.
hint: English letters, numbers and keyboard symbols. For other languages, use QR Code. Not GS1.

name: PDF417
description: A stacked two-dimensional barcode for larger text payloads and document workflows. Application-specific document formats require their own data rules.
hint: English letters, numbers and keyboard symbols. For other languages, use QR Code. Document-specific rules still apply.
